name: Solenne Atelier NeuralLink Cuff — Meridian Cut
description:
Broad wrist cuff in polished white gold over a titanium core, 52mm wide, set with a flush BCI interface port at the inner wrist. The outer face carries a tessellated pattern of hand-engraved geometric lines — a fusion of Yoruba adire geometry and Scandinavian knotwork, executed in negative relief so the metal catches light in shifting planes. A hairline ring of pale blue bioluminescent resin traces the port surround.

Worn as both a status signal and a functional interface device. The port connects directly to Spire-tier BCI hardware, allowing seamless neural handshake with secured corporate environments without exposing a raw port.
materials: polished white gold over titanium core
functionality: Integrated BCI port cover protects the neural interface from contamination and provides a clean hardwired handshake point for Spire-tier secure environments. Bioluminescent resin pulses faintly when an active BCI handshake is established. Sapphire port cover is rated for daily open-close cycles without wear degradation.
what_it_says: Power doesn't need to shout — it wears its access points like jewelry.
worn_by: power brokers who move between secured environments daily
story_hooks: The BCI port on a particular cuff has been subtly modified to log handshake signatures from every secure environment it accesses — someone has been building a map of Spire-level secure zones.
A cuff surfaces at a Tier 1 pawn operation with the engraving partially filed off — whoever brought it in either stole it or was paid to disappear it.
The bioluminescent resin is sourced from a single licensed geneware cultivar; tracing the resin batch can identify exactly which Solenne production run a cuff came from — and who purchased it.

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding broad wrist cuff that reads as both jewelry and industrial interface—polished white gold that catches light dramatically, sitting flush against the wrist like a statement of augmented privilege. The tessellated geometric pattern creates a subtle 3D effect that makes the cuff seem to shift and breathe with movement.
physical_description.fit: Precisely tailored to the wrist with a rigid titanium core—sits snug but not restrictive, designed for those accustomed to augmentation wear. The 52mm width commands presence without bulk.
physical_description.primary_material: Polished white gold over titanium core, with pale blue bioluminescent resin accent ring
physical_description.texture: Smooth polished outer surfaces with hand-engraved negative relief creating subtle tactile geometry—runs of light and shadow from the knotwork and adire patterns. The port surround is glossy resin.
physical_description.color_scheme: Bright white-gold primary with pale blue bioluminescent resin glowing softly around the inner port. The engraved lines create shadow-depth against the mirror finish.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit or magnetic clasp (implied by luxury design); the cuff is a rigid band without traditional fasteners
distinctive_features: Flush BCI interface port at inner wrist for direct neural handshake
Hand-engraved tessellated pattern blending Yoruba adire and Scandinavian knotwork in negative relief
Pale blue bioluminescent resin hairline ring framing the port
Polished white gold over titanium—high-grade materials signal extreme wealth
Catches and refracts light across geometric planes with movement
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — Spire-tier corporate, cutting-edge augmentation tech, hand-crafted by artisan brand
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by high-level corporate operatives, neural-integrated executives, and augmented elites who move through secured Spire environments. The cultural fusion of adire and knotwork signals cosmopolitan taste and hybrid heritage—a statement of individual identity within corporate uniformity.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine, meticulously maintained. The bioluminescent resin glows consistently; the engraving shows no wear. This is a piece kept in perfect condition as both tool and status symbol.
